title: Fuzzing of decoders
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation.

statements.label: Fuzzing of decoders
statements.requirement: The Base45, ZLIB, CBOR, COSE and full verifier entry points SHALL be fuzzed in CI (cargo-fuzz for Rust, Jazzer or kotlinx-fuzz for Kotlin). No input may crash them, hang them, or exceed DecodeLimits.

sources.quote: a potential attacker may attempt to inject carefully crafted information designed to compromise the security of the system
